value.title: Docs in the pij CLI: the pods page
value.summary: PRD 009 workstream step s03, its last page (req-05). `pij docs get pods` explains pods as PRD 008 shipped them, and the concepts page, the start page and building-a-role point at it.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: PRD 008 (#346) shipped pods: `pij pod plan|up|show|confirm|set|down|add|release|sessions|activity|stage` and `pij sessions --history`. `docs/cli/pods.md` describes them as main ships them: a template named by its path, plan's warnings that each name a fix and never refuse, up and its tool canary, the degraded-slot brake, `E-RS-POD-EXISTS`, `E-RS-POD-MEMBER`, the secret refusal on `--set`, stages and write-back, the freeze at down, keep-open members and revival. Template procedures and shipped pod templates (PRD 010) are in a Coming section. The page is bundled as `pods` in `pages()`; concepts drops pods from its Coming section, defines the pod term as shipped and adds pod records and subject memory; the start page, building-a-role and the community route point at it.

sections.name: goals
value: A seat reading `pij docs get pods` can plan, start, follow, change and take down a pod with what this pij ships.
Nothing on the page or in concepts describes PRD 010 as shipped.

sections.name: non_goals
value: A page generated from a pod-template catalog: PRD 008 compiles none in; templates are files a command names.
Any change to pod behaviour or refusals.

value.claim: `pij docs list` names `pods`, and `pij docs get pods` prints docs/cli/pods.md byte-for-byte; the docs-bundle check passes on the rebuilt binary.

The page covers each verb in `pij pod --help` and `pij sessions --history`, templates named by path, warnings with fixes, the degraded-slot brake, `E-RS-POD-EXISTS`, `E-RS-POD-MEMBER`, the freeze at down and keep-open members, each as main ships it, and marks template procedures and shipped templates as coming (PRD 010).

Concepts no longer calls pods planned; concepts, the start page, building-a-role and the community route point at `pij docs get pods`; PRD 009 req-05 is shipped and workstream 009 s03 complete, depending on 008 s02.

value.title: Pods page shipped
value.brief: One PR: the page, its bundling, the pointers and the states.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Sources for the page: `pij pod --help` from the deployed daemon (387362db), the Pods section of docs/how/pij-rs-api.md (PRD 008, plans 247-252), the pij/pod-template schema (.dd/schemas/pij/pod-template/schema.json) and crates/daemon/src/http/pod.rs (flags, refusal codes, the `subject` and `work-folder` parameters).

value.risk: The page drifts from the pod verbs as PRD 010 extends them.
value.mitigation: The Coming section names what PRD 010 adds; PRD 010's PR updates it, as this PR updates concepts for PRD 008.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: none. A bundled page is a compiled-in string; no loop, poll, timer, hook or launch, nothing per seat or per tick.
Pages are public-safe: no customer or person names.
